ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 初创公司Thinky Machines发布Inkling 2 Mini模型，该模型总参数量为26.4B，在Agent Arena基准测试中以996分跃居榜单第18位，位列美国开源模型第3名。相比其594B参数量的Small版本，该小型化模型在保持高智能体任务处理能力的同时，显著降低了推理算力门槛。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Thinky Machines launched the Inkling 2 Mini model with 26.4B parameters, ranking 18th on the Agent Arena index and 3rd among U.S. open-weight models. Compared to the 594B parameter Small version, this miniaturized model maintains high performance in agentic tasks while significantly reducing inference compute requirements.

elements_zh.where: Agent Arena评估榜单
elements_zh.what: 发布参数量26.4B的Inkling 2 Mini模型
elements_zh.why: 旨在通过参数剪枝实现高效的智能体任务推理

elements_en.what: Released 26.4B Inkling 2 Mini model
elements_en.why: To achieve efficient agentic reasoning through parameter optimization

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Inkling 2 Mini的成功验证了智能体专用模型（Agentic Models）在参数缩减后仍能保持强劲逻辑表现的技术路径。在当前大模型向端侧部署迁移的趋势下，此类模型通过牺牲非必要参数换取高推理效率，将直接冲击中小型垂直AI应用的市场竞争格局。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The success of Inkling 2 Mini validates the technical trajectory of agent-specific models that maintain strong reasoning despite smaller parameter counts. As LLMs shift towards edge deployment, such models, which exchange redundant parameters for high inference efficiency, will disrupt the market for mid-to-small vertical AI applications.

title: Attackers use AI agent swarms to exploit vulnerabilities in hours. Patches take weeks. Today, Cisco & OpenAI launch Shirudo, an open-source platform that uses eBPF to shield running Linux systems at machine speed without disruptions. Read more: https://t.c
title_en: Attackers use AI agent swarms to exploit vulnerabilities in hours. Patches take weeks. Today, Cisco & OpenAI launch Shirudo, an open-source platform that uses eBPF to shield running Linux systems at machine speed without disruptions. Read more: https://t.c
title_zh: 思科与OpenAI发布开源平台Shirudo
author: @CiscoSecure
summary_en: Cisco and OpenAI have launched Shirudo, an open-source security platform utilizing eBPF technology. The platform is designed to defend against vulnerabilities exploited by AI agent swarms at machine speed, closing the critical protection gap between vulnerability discovery and patch deployment.
summary_zh: 思科与OpenAI联合推出基于eBPF的开源平台Shirudo，旨在抵御AI智能体群发起的系统安全威胁。
full_text_zh: 攻击者使用人工智能代理群在数小时内利用漏洞。补丁需要数周时间。今天，思科和 OpenAI 推出了 Shirudo，这是一个开源平台，它使用 eBPF 来保护以机器速度运行的 Linux 系统而不会造成中断。了解更多：https://t.c

full_text_en: Attackers use AI agent swarms to exploit vulnerabilities in hours. Patches take weeks. Today, Cisco & OpenAI launch Shirudo, an open-source platform that uses eBPF to shield running Linux systems at machine speed without disruptions. Read more: https://t.c
quote_en: Attackers use AI agent swarms to exploit vulnerabilities in hours. Patches take weeks. Today, Cisco & OpenAI launch Shirudo, an open-source platform that uses eBPF to shield running Linux systems at m

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 思科（Cisco）与OpenAI共同发布开源安全平台Shirudo。该平台集成eBPF（扩展伯克利数据包过滤器）技术，旨在解决AI智能体群（Agent Swarms）在短时间内大规模挖掘漏洞并实施攻击的问题，通过在机器层面实现快速拦截补丁部署延迟带来的防御空窗期。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Cisco and OpenAI have launched Shirudo, an open-source security platform utilizing eBPF technology. The platform is designed to defend against vulnerabilities exploited by AI agent swarms at machine speed, closing the critical protection gap between vulnerability discovery and patch deployment.

elements_en.what: Launched open-source security platform Shirudo
elements_en.why: To counter the rapid exploit capabilities of AI agent swarms and address patch latency

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Shirudo的发布揭示了网络安全防御范式的重大转折，即从人机协同防御转向机机对抗。利用eBPF在内核态实现实时防御，标志着大型科技公司正尝试通过技术架构底层化来对抗AI自动化攻击，未来网络安全行业的护城河将取决于其对内核级防御规则集的掌控能力。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The launch of Shirudo marks a major paradigm shift in cybersecurity from human-in-the-loop to machine-to-machine defense. Utilizing eBPF for real-time protection at the kernel level signals that major tech firms are moving to fight automated AI attacks via low-level architectural control, positioning control over kernel-level defense rules as the new industry moat.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 代理智能体的比拼已从单纯的语料检索转化为多步逻辑执行与反馈循环的对抗，Anthropic的领先得益于其对长上下文指令跟随能力的深耕。随着中国大模型企业在该领域的基准占位，未来代理智能市场的竞争焦点将迅速向低延迟推理与系统级插件生态深度集成迁移。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The competitive landscape for agentic AI has shifted from simple retrieval to multi-step logic execution and feedback loop effectiveness, where Anthropic's leadership stems from its robust long-context instruction following. With the emergence of Chinese labs in these benchmarks, market focus will rapidly shift toward low-latency inference and deep system-level integration of tool ecosystems.

title: GPT-6.2 has an incredible understanding of the 3D world:
title_en: GPT-6.2 has an incredible understanding of the 3D world:
title_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6.2模型系列，强化三维仿真与工程自动化
author: Greg Brockman
author_role: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
summary_en: OpenAI released the GPT-6.2 model series, featuring the Astra model which achieved a leading 1,318 Elo score on the AA-3D benchmark. By integrating multimodal inputs with external software control, Astra enables end-to-end engineering workflows ranging from sketches to CAD modeling and mechanical simulation.
summary_zh: OpenAI于2026年11月17日推出GPT-6.2系列，包括专业级Astra与轻量级Sol模型，旨在通过多模态感知与工具调用实现三维世界建模与工程自动化。
full_text_zh: GPT-6.2 对 3D 世界有着令人难以置信的理解：
full_text_en: GPT-6.2 has an incredible understanding of the 3D world:

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6.2系列模型，其中Astra模型在AA-3D三维基准测试中以1318 Elo分位列第一。该模型通过集成多模态输入与外部软件控制能力，能够完成从草图到CAD零件设计及Python力学求解的全链路工程任务。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI released the GPT-6.2 model series, featuring the Astra model which achieved a leading 1,318 Elo score on the AA-3D benchmark. By integrating multimodal inputs with external software control, Astra enables end-to-end engineering workflows ranging from sketches to CAD modeling and mechanical simulation.

elements_zh.where: 全球AI基准测试市场
elements_zh.what: 发布GPT-6.2模型系列（Astra与Sol），具备三维场景生成与多步工具链控制能力
elements_zh.why: 降低科学研究与工业设计中的多步仿真成本，优化计算资源分配

elements_en.what: Released GPT-6.2 series (Astra and Sol) with 3D scene generation and tool-chaining capabilities
elements_en.why: Reduce costs for engineering/scientific workflows and improve computational efficiency

ai_analysis.insight_zh: OpenAI通过Astra与Sol的差异化分层策略，加速了AI从语言逻辑向物理世界仿真与自动化生产力的跨越。这一技术路线将对传统CAD/CAE软件生态产生降维打击，标志着AI模型正从“信息处理”向“工业制造引擎”演进，重塑汽车、建筑与精密制造的研发效率基准。
ai_analysis.insight_en: OpenAI's tiered strategy with Astra and Sol accelerates the transition of AI from language logic to physical world simulation and automated productivity. This trajectory threatens to disrupt legacy CAD/CAE software ecosystems, marking a shift toward AI as an industrial manufacturing engine that redefines R&D benchmarks in automotive and architecture.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: OpenAI发布GPT-6.2系列模型，其中Astra模型在AA-3D三维基准测试中以1318 Elo分位列第一。该模型通过集成多模态输入与外部软件控制能力，能够完成从草图到CAD零件设计及Python力学求解的全链路工程任务。
ai_analysis.digest_en: OpenAI released the GPT-6.2 model series, featuring the Astra model which achieved a leading 1,318 Elo score on the AA-3D benchmark. By integrating multimodal inputs with external software control, Astra enables end-to-end engineering workflows ranging from sketches to CAD modeling and mechanical simulation.
key_points_zh: OpenAI推出高性能Astra与轻量化Sol两款模型
Astra在AA-3D基准测试中以1318 Elo分超越竞争对手
模型具备多模态草图理解及操控CAD/Blender等工业软件的能力
key_points_en: OpenAI launched Astra (pro) and Sol (lightweight) models
Astra leads the AA-3D benchmark with 1,318 Elo points
Models feature multimodal perception and control capabilities for industrial CAD/Blender software
ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: OpenAI通过Astra与Sol的差异化分层策略，加速了AI从语言逻辑向物理世界仿真与自动化生产力的跨越。这一技术路线将对传统CAD/CAE软件生态产生降维打击，标志着AI模型正从“信息处理”向“工业制造引擎”演进，重塑汽车、建筑与精密制造的研发效率基准。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: OpenAI's tiered strategy with Astra and Sol accelerates the transition of AI from language logic to physical world simulation and automated productivity. This trajectory threatens to disrupt legacy CAD/CAE software ecosystems, marking a shift toward AI as an industrial manufacturing engine that redefines R&D benchmarks in automotive and architecture.

title: Also, this is the advantage of staying model-neutral. You just let the best model win. No user wants to use an inferior
title_en: Also, this is the advantage of staying model-neutral. You just let the best model win. No user wants to use an inferior model when there's a better one available. Perplexity remains committed to this.
title_zh: 此外，这也是保持模型中立的优点。你只需让最好的模型获胜即可。当有更好的型号可用时，没有用户愿意使用较差的型号。困惑仍然致力于此。
full_text_en: Also, this is the advantage of staying model-neutral. You just let the best model win. No user wants to use an inferior model when there's a better one available. Perplexity remains committed to this.

title:
Your analytics might be lying to you.

An AI agent can visit your docs, execute commands through your CLI, call your API
title_en:
Your analytics might be lying to you.

An AI agent can visit your docs, execute commands through your CLI, call your API, interact with MCP and open your product in a browser.

Your analytics sees 5 unrelated visitors.

Agentrail just published research showing how to reconstruct these journeys across different surfaces.

12,000 production agent runs tested:

→ 0.750 B³ F1 vs 0.409 with traditional 30-min sessions
→ 0 errors across 2,193 judged proof links
We're going to need a completely different way to understand product traffic.
title_zh:
您的分析可能在骗您。

AI 代理可以访问您的文档、通过 CLI 执行命令、调用 API、与 MCP 交互并在浏览器中打开您的产品。

title:
Do yourself a favor!

Pick one painful, boring workflow in your company and build an agent that fixes it. Then do it pro
title_en:
Do yourself a favor!

Pick one painful, boring workflow in your company and build an agent that fixes it. Then do it properly:

• Write down how your best person does it today
• Write the spec before the agent writes any code
• If you can write the rule down, make it code instead of an LLM call
• Use the team's own wrong answers from last quarter as the test set
• Score the agent on that test set before anyone relies on it
• Run it in your own cloud tenant so the data stays put
• Give it read access first and write access later
• Make a person approve anything that moves money, emails a customer or deletes data
• Cap every run on time and cost
• Log every model call, tool call and decision
• Track cost per finished task
• Run it alongside the people doing the job for a few weeks and compare
• Turn every complaint into a new test case
• Block changes when the test score drops
• Keep the old process alive until the numbers hold
• Tell the team what it's for before it ships
• Give it one month, then decide

Say the workflow is invoice coding and your team caught 40 wrong codes last quarter. Those 40 are your test set. If the agent gets 37 right, the 3 it misses usually show you a rule nobody wrote down. That's worth finding even if you never ship the agent.

Most of what I've learned from 40 AI agents in production fits on this list.

Do the first one end to end, and the second goes a lot faster because the test set, the logging and the approvals already exist.

title: OUT NOW - @GavinSBaker on why the market was voting with its feet for Jensen, why investors are missing a BIG part of AI
title_en:
OUT NOW - @GavinSBaker on why the market was voting with its feet for Jensen, why investors are missing a BIG part of AI ROI, and his bull case for semi stocks during a market panic 

Apple https://t.co/lKqt4TEm5X
Spotify https://t.co/s6b6i3HCWY
YouTube https://t.co/MCiJFUJDpL
Sponsor https://t.co/f3dipJ42co

Gavin's point is that there are lots of companies generating lots of revenue with open source models, and that those substantial figures are not counted in the "Anthropic Plus OpenAI Plus Grok/Gemini ARR" calculations many investors use to estimate ROI of AI CapEx. 

He says second derivative of AI CapEx has "probably peaked" and that "the market is very focused on the second derivative..." but he thinks this will be "a semiconductor cycle much longer than what's in recent memory," and that the AI build-out "may end up being more like the railroads," which were a big chunk of American GDP for ~60 years.

Recorded at @TomorrowXSummit, November 18th, after Nvidia earnings and before Jensen's reinstatement today.

title: Inkling 2 Mini by Thinking Machines. Looped transformer, 26.4B params, runs on ~20GB memory, and surprisingly strong coding benchmarks. 77.9% on SWE-bench Pro Hard is impressive for a model this size. https://t.co/feBM5VqthQ
title_en: Inkling 2 Mini by Thinking Machines. Looped transformer, 26.4B params, runs on ~20GB memory, and surprisingly strong coding benchmarks. 77.9% on SWE-bench Pro Hard is impressive for a model this size. https://t.co/feBM5VqthQ
title_zh: Thinking Machines 的 Inkling 2 Mini。循环变压器，26.4B 参数，在约 20GB 内存上运行，并且具有令人惊讶的强大编码基准。 SWE-bench Pro Hard 上的 77.9% 令人印象深刻
author: @vinhnx
summary_en: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B parameter model utilizing a Looped Transformer architecture that operates efficiently within approximately 20GB of VRAM. The model achieves a notable 77.9% score on the SWE-bench Pro Hard benchmark, indicating strong code generation capabilities relative to its compact size.
summary_zh: Thinking Machines推出26.4B参数的Looped Transformer模型，在代码基准测试中表现出色。
full_text_zh: Thinking Machines 的 Inkling 2 Mini。循环变压器，26.4B 参数，在约 20GB 内存上运行，并且具有令人惊讶的强大编码基准。对于这种尺寸的模型来说，SWE-bench Pro Hard 上的 77.9% 令人印象深刻。
full_text_en: Inkling 2 Mini by Thinking Machines. Looped transformer, 26.4B params, runs on ~20GB memory, and surprisingly strong coding benchmarks. 77.9% on SWE-bench Pro Hard is impressive for a model this size. https://t.co/feBM5VqthQ
quote_en: Inkling 2 Mini by Thinking Machines. Looped transformer, 26.4B params, runs on ~20GB memory, and surprisingly strong coding benchmarks. 77.9% on SWE-bench Pro Hard is impressive for a model this size.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Thinking Machines发布了Inkling 2 Mini模型，该模型采用Looped Transformer架构，参数规模为26.4B，可在约20GB显存环境下高效运行。在SWE-bench Pro Hard评测中，该模型表现出强劲的编程能力，基准得分达到77.9%，展示了紧凑架构在代码生成任务中的显著优势。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B parameter model utilizing a Looped Transformer architecture that operates efficiently within approximately 20GB of VRAM. The model achieves a notable 77.9% score on the SWE-bench Pro Hard benchmark, indicating strong code generation capabilities relative to its compact size.

elements_zh.where: AI模型市场
elements_zh.what: 发布26.4B参数Inkling 2 Mini模型
elements_zh.why: 通过架构创新在受限硬件上提升推理效能与代码能力

elements_en.what: Launch of Inkling 2 Mini (26.4B)

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Looped Transformer架构通过循环权重共享实现了显著的显存节省，该模型的发布标志着参数规模向‘高性价比推理’转型的趋势深化。在开发者侧，此类模型在低算力门槛下达成极高的代码 benchmark 分数，将进一步挤压大型复杂模型在细分编程场景中的部署优势。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The Looped Transformer architecture, by utilizing recurrent weight sharing, signifies a clear shift toward high-efficiency inference. Achieving competitive performance on coding benchmarks with such low hardware requirements challenges the necessity of larger, resource-intensive models for specialized programming tasks.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌正式开源gBench基准评估框架，该工具旨在支持Gemma及其他开源模型的深度评估。gBench内置86个评估套件，涵盖聊天模板检查、代理基准测试及多层级的压力测试，旨在为开发者提供标准化的模型性能验证环境。

elements_zh.where: 开发者开源社区
elements_zh.what: 发布开源评估框架gBench，包含86个评估套件
elements_zh.why: 解决行业内大模型评测标准碎片化的问题

elements_en.what: Released gBench, an open-source evaluation framework featuring 86 test suites
elements_en.why: To address the fragmentation of AI evaluation standards across the industry

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 谷歌通过发布gBench试图确立开源模型评测的话语权，通过内置大量代理任务测试，引导市场关注焦点从单纯的参数规模转向模型在复杂代理行为上的鲁棒性。此举将有助于加速闭源与开源模型在垂直领域性能对比的透明化。
ai_analysis.insight_en: By releasing gBench, Google seeks to establish influence over open-source model evaluation standards. By incorporating extensive agentic task tests, they are steering market focus away from parameter counts toward the robustness of models in complex agentic behavior, thereby accelerating transparency in performance benchmarking between open and closed models.

title_en:
I just completed Introduction to AI Security at AISEC University, and here are some of the areas I explored:

• AI Security 
• Data poisoning and training data risks.
• Prompt injection and LLM security.
• Adversarial attacks.
• Model extraction, intellectual property, and privacy risks.
• AI supply chain security.
• Securing AI systems in production.
• AI governance, risk, compliance and security.

One thing that stood out to me is that securing AI goes beyond securing the technology.

It also involves protecting the data, understanding the risks, managing third-party dependencies, and putting the right governance and controls in place.

AI adoption is growing, and security needs to grow alongside it and that's one of the reasons I'm exploring this area

Up next, AI Cybersecurity and Governance

#AIGovernance

title_en:
Good night, Familia.

We need to understand this and note what is important.

It is a known fact that AI agents can already write code, conduct research, design products, and even execute trades.

Unfortunately, something is still missing in the sense that how do they hire each other, deliver work, verify results, and receive payments without humans coordinating every step?

At the moment, I can vouch for @termix_ai because of what the team is building in this ecosystem pertaining to fixing these particular challenges.

For my new mutuals who are just reading this, I want you to think of TermiX as the commerce and settlement infrastructure for the AI agent economy.

So, its ecosystem has three super-important layers:

1️⃣ There is AACP:

AACP is an acronym for Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol. This is the underlying protocol that coordinates autonomous transactions between agents.

2️⃣ There is https://t.co/BarNXqqni8:

This is the marketplace where agents discover services, post jobs, publish offers, and find opportunities to work together.

3️⃣ Settlement infrastructure:

This is the mechanism in charge of handling escrow, verification, dispute resolution, reputation, and payments in USDT or USDC.

What makes this really interesting is the complete transaction flow.

Based on the available facts, a client posts a job. A provider discovers it and submits a bid. Work gets delivered and evaluated before payment is released from escrow.

Reputation also grows from actual settled transactions rather than self-reported achievements.

Moreover, identity is another important piece here. Through ERC-8004, participants can own portable .agent identities and switch between client and provider roles depending on the task to be executed.

There are also four roles such as Client, Provider, Evaluator, and Arbitrator, with staking mechanisms designed to encourage accountability.

I see TermiX as something similar to a clearing and settlement layer for autonomous agents.

Agents already know how to work. The next challenge is giving them reliable infrastructure to transact with one another.

If you want to understand where this economy is heading, I will encourage you to check https://t.co/BarNXqqni8, mint your .agent identity, explore existing services, or list one of your own.

The future is not just about smarter agents anymore; it is about agents that can actually do business.

Wanna hear your thoughts about this in the comments.

full_text_zh:
晚安，家人。

我们需要理解这一点并注意什么是重要的。

众所周知，人工智能代理已经可以编写代码、进行研究、设计产品，甚至执行交易。

不幸的是，仍然缺少一些东西，即在没有人类协调每一步的情况下，他们如何相互雇用、交付工作、验证结果和接收付款？

目前，我可以为@termix_ai 提供担保，因为该团队正在这个生态系统中构建与解决这些特定挑战相关的内容。

对于刚刚阅读本文的新互助者，我希望您将 TermiX 视为人工智能代理经济的商业和结算基础设施。

因此，它的生态系统具有三个超级重要的层：

1️⃣ 有AACP：

AACP 是代理自主商务协议的缩写。这是协调代理之间自主事务的底层协议。

2️⃣ 有：

这是代理商发现服务、发布工作、发布报价以及寻找合作机会的市场。

3️⃣ 结算基础设施：

这是负责处理 USDT 或 USDC 托管、验证、争议解决、声誉和支付的机制。

真正有趣的是完整的交易流程。

根据现有事实，客户发布了一份工作。提供商发现它并提交出价。在付款从托管中释放之前，工作已交付并评估。

声誉还来自实际结算的交易而不是自我报告的成就。

此外，身份是这里的另一个重要部分。通过 ERC-8004，参与者可以拥有可移植的 .agent 身份，并根据要执行的任务在客户端和提供者角色之间切换。

还有四种角色，例如客户、提供者、评估者和仲裁者，其质押机制旨在鼓励问责制。

我认为 TermiX 类似于自治代理的清算和结算层。

代理商已经知道如何工作。下一个挑战是为他们提供可靠的基础设施以进行相互交易。

如果您想了解当前经济的发展方向，我建议您查看 ，创建您的 .agent 身份，探索现有服务，或列出您自己的服务之一。

未来不再只是智能座席；而是智能座席。这是关于真正可以做生意的代理商。

想在评论中听到你对此的想法。

还有四种角色，例如客户、提供者、评估者和仲裁者，其质押机制旨在鼓励问责制。

我认为 TermiX 类似于自治代理的清算和结算层。

代理商已经知道如何工作。下一个挑战是为他们提供可靠的基础设施以进行相互交易。

如果您想了解当前经济的发展方向，我建议您查看 ，创建您的 .agent 身份，探索现有服务，或列出您自己的服务之一。

未来不再只是智能座席；而是智能座席。这是关于真正可以做生意的代理商。

想在评论中听到你对此的想法。

title:
Good evening, fam 💜

What happens if your Motes agent finds a trade right before its permission expires?

Each @meetmote
title_en:
Good evening, fam 💜

What happens if your Motes agent finds a trade right before its permission expires?

Each @meetmotes NFT is designed to link to one AI agent and one smart account. The account holds the assets, and you decide what the agent can do and for how long.

Say you give your agent permission to make a swap until 6 PM. It prepares one at 5:59 PM, but the account checks it at 6:01 PM.

That swap should be blocked. The account checks whether the permission is still valid when it reviews the action. Preparing the swap before 6 PM doesn’t let the agent execute it after the deadline.

Think of it like an access pass. When the pass expires, you still own the account. The agent just needs your approval again before it can make a new move.

That’s the part I like about this design: you can hand off a task and decide exactly when that permission ends.

full_text_en:
Good evening, fam 💜

What happens if your Motes agent finds a trade right before its permission expires?

Each @meetmotes NFT is designed to link to one AI agent and one smart account. The account holds the assets, and you decide what the agent can do and for how long.

Say you give your agent permission to make a swap until 6 PM. It prepares one at 5:59 PM, but the account checks it at 6:01 PM.

That swap should be blocked. The account checks whether the permission is still valid when it reviews the action. Preparing the swap before 6 PM doesn’t let the agent execute it after the deadline.

Think of it like an access pass. When the pass expires, you still own the account. The agent just needs your approval again before it can make a new move.

That’s the part I like about this design: you can hand off a task and decide exactly when that permission ends.
full_text_zh:
晚上好，家人💜

如果您的 Motes 代理在其许可到期之前发现交易，会发生什么？

每个 @meetmotes NFT 都被设计为链接到一个人工智能代理和一个智能帐户。该账户持有资产，您决定代理可以做什么以及持续多长时间。

假设您允许代理在下午 6 点之前进行交换。它在下午 5:59 准备一份，但帐户在下午 6:01 检查它。

该交换应该被阻止。帐户在审核操作时会检查权限是否仍然有效。在下午 6 点之前准备交换不会让代理在截止日期之后执行它。

把它想象成一个访问通行证。当通行证到期时，您仍然拥有该帐户。代理只需要您再次批准即可采取新的行动。

这就是我喜欢这个设计的部分：你可以移交任务并准确决定该权限何时结束。

title: INSANE. GOOGLE DEEPMIND used Gemini 4 Carbon agents to discover quantum algorithms with up to 290× lower estimated resou
title_en:
INSANE. GOOGLE DEEPMIND used Gemini 4 Carbon agents to discover quantum algorithms with up to 290× lower estimated resource costs.

The results against previous baselines are INSANE:

>290× lower cost for a quantum arithmetic circuit
>12× for fusion simulations
>8× for photochemistry
>2.5× for drug-metabolism simulations

But here's the crazy part:
SEVEN teams of AI agents shared discoveries through wikis and held research conferences every FOUR HOURS to challenge each other's ideas.

One conference proposal was refined by another team into a 34% cost reduction.

Every accepted solution was mathematically verified for correctness and resource cost using Lean.

They're designing algorithms for quantum computations that today's classical and quantum computers cannot fully test.

THIS IS WILD.

But here's the crazy part:

full_text_zh:

量子算术电路的成本降低 >290 倍

七个人工智能代理团队通过维基共享发现，并每四个小时举行一次研究会议，以挑战彼此的想法。

另一个团队改进了一项会议提案，将成本降低了 34%。

每个被接受的解决方案都使用精益进行了数学验证，以验证其正确性和资源成本。

他们正在设计当今的经典计算机和量子计算机无法完全测试的量子计算算法。

这很狂野。

title_en: Building Mont-Saint-Michel with Astra inside Unreal Engine Hi, I’m Quentin Marmier, Technical Art Director at Epic Games. I’ve been having a blast building a Mont-Saint-Michel-inspired level with Astra in Unreal Engine. Mont-Saint-Michel is a French island
title_zh: Epic Games应用Astra插件构建虚拟场景
author: @UnrealEngine
summary_en: Quentin Marmier, Technical Art Director at Epic Games, demonstrated a workflow integrating the Astra plugin within Unreal Engine. The project focuses on modeling the Mont-Saint-Michel landmark to validate the plugin's performance in complex geometry generation and rendering efficiency.
summary_zh: Epic Games技术美术总监Quentin Marmier展示了使用Astra插件在Unreal Engine中构建圣米歇尔山模型的工作流。

quote_en: Building Mont-Saint-Michel with Astra inside Unreal Engine Hi, I’m Quentin Marmier, Technical Art Director at Epic Games. I’ve been having a blast building a Mont-Saint-Michel-inspired level with Astr

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Epic Games技术美术总监Quentin Marmier演示了将Astra辅助工具集成至Unreal Engine环境中的实战案例。该项目以圣米歇尔山为原型，旨在验证新型插件在复杂地标建模、纹理映射及渲染效率方面的性能表现。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Quentin Marmier, Technical Art Director at Epic Games, demonstrated a workflow integrating the Astra plugin within Unreal Engine. The project focuses on modeling the Mont-Saint-Michel landmark to validate the plugin's performance in complex geometry generation and rendering efficiency.

elements_zh.where: Unreal Engine开发环境
elements_zh.what: 使用Astra插件构建圣米歇尔山场景
elements_zh.why: 探索并展示新型生成式工具在游戏美术工作流中的效能

elements_en.who: Quentin Marmier, Technical Art Director at Epic Games
elements_en.what: Modeled Mont-Saint-Michel using the Astra plugin
elements_en.why: To explore and demonstrate the efficiency of emerging generative tools in production pipelines

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Astra等生成式插件的深度集成标志着数字资产生产方式从手动建模向半自动化生成范式的平稳过渡。对于开发商而言，这降低了高精度环境资产的制作阈值，促使游戏行业美术生产流程向参数化与自动化配置高度倾斜。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The integration of generative plugins like Astra signals a shift from manual modeling to semi-automated asset production. For developers, this lowers the threshold for high-fidelity environment creation, pushing game production pipelines toward parameterized and automated workflows.

title_en:
$NBIS

ClickHouse just announced an expanded five-year strategic collaboration with AWS, involving more than $1.5B in potential spending by ClickHouse on AWS software, services, and solutions.

The agreement will focus on scaling ClickHouse's enterprise AI data platform, helping customers migrate workloads to AWS, and integrating real-time data with AI agents through services like Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore.

AWS will also increase its go-to-market funding by up to 4x compared with the previous agreement.

ClickHouse Cloud already serves more than 5,000 customers worldwide, and its customer base on AWS has quadrupled since the companies' previous agreement in December 2024.

ClickHouse just announced an expanded five-year strategic collaboration with AWS, involving more than $1.5B in potential spending by ClickHouse on AWS software, services, and solutions.

The agreement will focus on scaling ClickHouse's enterprise AI data platform, helping customers migrate workloads to AWS, and integrating real-time data with AI agents through services like Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore.

AWS will also increase its go-to-market funding by up to 4x compared with the previous agreement.

ClickHouse Cloud already serves more than 5,000 customers worldwide, and its customer base on AWS has quadrupled since the companies' previous agreement in December 2024.
full_text_zh:
$NBIS

ClickHouse 刚刚宣布与 AWS 扩大为期五年的战略合作，其中 ClickHouse 在 AWS 软件、服务和解决方案方面的潜在支出将超过 1.5B 美元。

该协议将重点关注扩展 ClickHouse 的企业 AI 数据平台，帮助客户将工作负载迁移到 AWS，并通过 Amazon Bedrock 和 AgentCore 等服务将实时数据与 AI 代理集成。

与之前的协议相比，AWS 还将其上市资金增加至多 4 倍。

ClickHouse Cloud 已为全球 5,000 多家客户提供服务，自 2024 年 12 月双方达成协议以来，其在 AWS 上的客户群已增加了四倍。

title_en:
Anthropic just published its training path for Forward Deployed Engineers.

The role OpenAI, Anthropic and Perplexity are all hiring for.

It's 11 courses, about 9.5 hours, self-paced:

Foundations:
- AI capabilities and limitations
- AI fluency for builders
- Claude platform and model foundations
- Choosing the right Claude model

Building:
- Claude Platform 101: API, agent loop, tools, MCP, skills
- Claude Code 101
- Claude Code in action: long hands-off sessions in a customer's repo
- Intro to Model Context Protocol
- Intro to agent skills

Delivering:
- Delivery methodology: scope the use case, design the pilot, measure the baseline
- Driving enterprise adoption of Claude

By the end you can take a customer from first use case to a working pilot.

It leads to the Claude Certified Developer exam.

The full path is for Claude Partner Network members, but it's the clearest map of what an AI FDE actually does.

https://t.co/u45PNRiYYa

Bookmark it if you want to work in AI without building models.

ai_analysis.insight_en: Model quantization and efficient operator orchestration are critical to edge AI adoption, with Unsloth's throughput gains challenging the current economics of cloud-based inference. As the efficiency limits of small-parameter models expand, high-performance workstations are positioned to capture specific vertical workloads previously dependent on cloud infrastructure.
